name: third-basket-leg-yarn
description: The whole suite and lints still pass, then the checks that the new leg is real: configured, factory-verified, associated by the live script, tested at three legs, documented, and the UI and contract untouched. Nothing here needs a secret; factory-pool reads the testnet RPC (HEDERA_RPC_URL overrides Hashio).

commands.name: contracts-test
commands.purpose: The whole offline suite, new tests included.

commands.name: contracts-lint
commands.purpose: forge fmt --check on the new test and script.

commands.name: app-types
commands.purpose: Strict type check of the app.

commands.name: deploy-legs
commands.purpose: At least three legs, old two kept, weights under 10000, the NatSpec percentages match.

commands.name: factory-pool
commands.purpose: Each pool is factory.getPool(token, WHBAR, fee) on the RPC, pairs the token with WHBAR and has liquidity.

commands.name: third-leg-test
commands.purpose: BasketVaultThirdLeg.t.sol runs at least two tests, all green, one on deposit and one on redeem.

commands.name: docs-counts
commands.purpose: README and AGENTS print the test and suite totals forge reports.

commands.name: ui-generic
commands.purpose: No token symbol, leg address, fixed leg index or leg count in the fund UI.

commands.name: protected-paths
commands.purpose: BasketVault.sol and the existing tests are unchanged.
